channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Secret Abu Dhabi meeting | Report: Netanyahu's unusual request from UAE President
item.description: AP reports Netanyahu secretly met UAE President bin Zayed to seek a denial of claims he had warned Israel of an impending Hamas attack before October 7.

item.title: Ben Gvir on Temple Mount: ‘We are the masters here’
item.description: National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir ascends Temple Mount, calling for Israeli sovereignty over the site and declares that Israel is on the path to total victory.

item.title: Celebrating Sukkot under fire: IDF deploys 2,200 tactical sukkahs
item.description: The IDF Military Rabbinate distributes 18,500 sukkahs, including 2,200 tactical models designed to conceal troops, and 13,000 Four Species sets.

item.title: Jewish professor alleges antisemitism at Duquesne
item.description: Brandeis Center files federal complaint alleging Jewish professor faced antisemitic harassment, professional retaliation, after reporting discrimination at Duquesne University.

item.title: How the IDF’s Urban Warfare Doctrine drives a soldier crisis
item.description: The psychological impact of close- quarters urban combat is uniquely devastating. House-to-house fighting is deeply visceral. It involves face-to-face violence, the immediate sight of casualties, and the constant fear of sudden ambush in enclosed spaces. It is avoidable and must be changed. Opinion.

item.title: Rabbi Lando warns: ‘Torah world facing existential battle’
item.description: Amid escalating tensions over haredi enlistment, Lithuanian-haredi leader Rabbi Dov Landau warns yeshiva students of struggle for Torah study, urges them to continue learning.

item.title: Young Christians unite against campus antisemitism
item.description: Over 250 Christian students and emerging leaders attend Passages' Israel Impact Summit, receiving training to support Jewish students, counter misinformation and strengthen ties with Israel.

item.title: The ultimate symbol of the tragedy of Jewish powerlessness
item.description: In Florence, I found myself seeing the crucifixion in a totally different way. Opinion.

item.title: 'Torah that listens to broken hearts': Dog joins Torah giants at Sukkot event
item.description: After suffering PTSD from his wartime service tending to the fallen, Rabbi Menachem Perl attends a Sukkot gathering with his emotional support dog.

item.title: German city bans stumbling stone memorials to Nazi victims
item.description: German town's decision to ban new Holocaust memorial stones from its sidewalks sparks outrage, critics accuse local politicians of pushing Nazi victims' memory out of public life.

item.title: Watching pure evil as Jew-hating Europe lectures Israel about morality
item.description: Europe, forever soaked in Jewish blood, boycotts Jewish businesses just as the Nazis did. Op-ed.

item.title: Report: Hamas still has 30,000 armed terrorists, is rebuilding its arsenal
item.description: Nearly three years after October 7, Hamas retains thousands of armed terrorists, maintains tunnel network, manufactures rockets, and smuggles weapons into Gaza.

item.title: Huckabee: Jerusalem is unlike any other city in the world
item.description: At a festive Sukkot reception attended by diplomats from dozens of countries, Huckabee praises Jerusalem's unique character and 3,000-year history.

item.title: Rain on Sukkot? Wintry weather heads towards Israel
item.description: Autumn arrives during Sukkot holiday as temperatures drop, scattered showers and additional rain system expected.

item.title: Former Mossad official: I don't remember any warnings from Egypt or UAE
item.description: Former Mossad official Eyal Tsir Cohen says Egyptian intelligence officials never mentioned any prior October 7 warning, despite dozens of hours of talks.

item.title: Despite ignorance claim: Balad Chief repeated remarks days after October 7
item.description: Video shows Balad chief repeating his controversial remarks days after October 7, contradicting his claim of ignorance about the massacre.

item.title: Watch live: Tens of thousands attend annual 'Priestly Blessing' ceremony
item.description: Traditional Priestly Blessing ceremony begins at Western Wall, attended by tens of thousands.

item.title: You cannot sanction geography
item.description: The UN can blacklist companies. It cannot move the Judean hills, widen Israel’s coastal plain or make strategic vulnerability disappear. Opinion.

item.title: Watch: IDF takes out Hamas sniper threatening troops in Gaza
item.description: Hamas sniper Adi Adli Abd Al-Aaser eliminated in southern Gaza after advancing attacks against Israeli forces and civilians.

item.title: Ontario man arrested after livestream threats targeting Jewish community
item.description: 33-year-old Kitchener man faces a hate-motivated threats charge after police investigate a livestream containing antisemitic threats against Jews.

item.title: US envoy Waltz dismisses Iran ceasefire proposal as 'pretty cynical attempt'
item.description: US envoy to the UN calls Iran’s seven-day ceasefire proposal a “pretty cynical attempt" to win sanctions relief and access frozen funds.

item.title: Reports in Lebanon of Israel Air Force strikes in southern Lebanon
item.description: Lebanese media reported that the Air Force carried out a strike this morning in the Wadi Zebqin area of southern Lebanon.

item.title: Report: Eight US Marines injured in previously undisclosed Iranian missile attack
item.description: NBC News reports that eight US Marines suffered injuries including smoke inhalation and concussion symptoms in Iranian missile attack in Hormuz.

item.title: During soccer match: Irish players refuse handshakes with Israel, bow heads during anthem
item.description: Ireland beats Israel 3-0 in a tense Nations League match marked by no handshakes, black armbands and amid political tensions between the two countries.

item.title: Trump: We’re going to win this war very soon
item.description: Trump tells Fox News the US will win the war with Iran soon as Washington and Tehran remain divided over nuclear concessions, Hormuz and a potential deal.

item.title: Report: Egypt’s intelligence chief warned Netanyahu days before October 7
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel personally warned Netanyahu about the possibility of an impending Hamas attack days before the October 7, 2023 massacre.

item.title: Shin Bet Chief orders personal protection for Gadi Eisenkot
item.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini approves a personal security detail for Gadi Eisenkot, while a decision on protection for Yair Golan remains pending.

item.title: 9-year-old boy pepper-sprayed in Jerusalem, suspect arrested
item.description: Police arrest a 22-year-old suspect over the pepper-spray attack on a nine-year-old Armenian Christian boy in Jerusalem's Mamilla neighborhood on Yom Kippur.

item.title: Ben-Gvir vows to see Hamas terrorist executed
item.description: Decades after protesting against Hassan Salameh’s deadly terror campaign, National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir met the terrorist in prison and said he would work to see Hassan put to death.

item.title: Iran warns US of 'doomsday war,' claims it has changed military tactics
item.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi tells NBC that Tehran is prepared for a 'doomsday war' with the US but remains willing to pursue diplomacy.
